set_value.name: $healthy
set_value.exact: player.spacesuit.exists and player.controlled == player.spacesuit and player.entity.controlled == player.spacesuit and not player.room.exists

do_if.value: not $healthy and $source.exists and $source.isclass.ship and not $source.isclass.spacesuit and $zone.isclass.zone and $source.sector == $zone.sector and $source.sector == player.sector and not @$source.dock.container.exists and (player.room.hascontext.{$source} or player.ship == $source or player.spacesuit.exists)

debug_text.text: 'GO spacesuit exit requested: source=%1 controlled=%2 suit=%3 room=%4'.[$source,player.controlled,player.spacesuit,player.room]

do_elseif.value: not Init.$Source.exists or player.sector != Init.$Sector or Init.$Source.sector != Init.$Sector or @Init.$Source.dock.container.exists or player.occupiedship.exists or (player.room.exists and player.room != Init.$Room) or (player.ship.exists and player.ship != Init.$Source and not player.ship.isclass.spacesuit)

write_to_logbook.title: 'Galactic Occupations: spacesuit exit still in transit'
write_to_logbook.text: 'The confirmed spacesuit exit remained in a native transfer for thirty game seconds. Recovery stopped; no repeated forced exits. Return to a ship using Teleport To if available, then retry Use Spacesuit. Save the debug log if controls remain unavailable.'

do_elseif.value: player.age ge Init.$Due and not player.entity.isintransit and not player.isinconversation

debug_text.text: 'GO spacesuit exit recovery: source=%1 controlled=%2 suit=%3 room=%4'.[Init.$Source,player.controlled,player.spacesuit,player.room]

write_to_logbook.title: if $healthy then 'Galactic Occupations: spacesuit recovery verified' else 'Galactic Occupations: spacesuit recovery unconfirmed'
write_to_logbook.text: if $healthy then 'The delayed native recovery completed: player and controls are in the spacesuit outside a ship room. No ship crew, equipment or orders were changed.' else 'One native spacesuit recovery was attempted after a confirmed exit stalled. The game has not reported a complete suit/control/room handoff; no further forced attempts will run. Save the debug log and return to a ship using Teleport To if available.'

debug_text.text: 'GO spacesuit recovery result: verified=%1 controlled=%2 suit=%3 room=%4 transit=%5'.[$healthy,player.controlled,player.spacesuit,player.room,player.entity.isintransit]
